note: Upstream checkouts are read-only and must stay git-clean. The runtime tree is generated from them by pipelines/assemble_runtime.py; nothing of ours is written into them.

rlinf.note: OpenVLA-OFT and prismatic are installed into this checkout's .venv as site-packages, not checked out separately; the patches under overlays/openvla/ target them there.

robot_model.note: The Panthera embodiment is generated from the official ROS 2 model, not vendored. overlays/robotwin/assets/embodiments/panthera_phone/provenance.json records the input hashes; packages/panthera_sim/build_panthera_embodiment.py rebuilds the meshes deterministically.
